Yes, that fits well. My note "Try the crispy roast potatoes for Sunday dinner" sits in its own highlighted "Your note" box, clearly set apart from the page's own description underneath the title, so I can tell at a glance which words are mine versus what was gathered automatically. And the "Edit note" link means I can go back and change my mind. That's just how I'd want to jot my own thoughts on a bookmark.

One thing I'd like to check when it's convenient: sometimes my note is more than a single sentence, and I'd like a little formatting — a couple of bullet points or a bit of emphasis — and to have it show up nicely formatted when I look at the bookmark later. Is that something this note can handle?
